steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song info
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (\S+)', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            release = m.group(3).strip()
            if release == 'TODO':
                # Split artists by comma
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} TODO songs")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)

for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song info
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (\S+)', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            release = m.group(3).strip()
            if release == 'TODO':
                # Split artists by comma
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} TODO songs")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)
